inputs.CREATION_REQUEST: Create and validate the edge-router-runtime Terminus task as a production-characteristic Go HTTP edge-routing and traffic-management runtime. Implement generation-safe dynamic route and upstream reconciliation with per-source revision/digest authority, immutable complete serving snapshots, request-held generation leases, stable endpoint identity/incarnation semantics, health-aware weighted/sticky retry/failover, bounded draining and retirement, durable checkpoint/restart recovery, bounded lifecycle telemetry, and the documented public CLI/operator/data-plane contracts while preserving unrelated in-flight traffic across concurrent updates.
